title: Symplectic Stafford: Lean 4 formalization checkpoint
description: Lean 4 formalization checkpoint for the symplectic Stafford same-divisor programme. The repository proves the original-ring semantic and ordered-algebra interfaces, finite right-denominator clearing, and a finite-length pencil lemma, with a Mathlib-only Challenge/Solution pair. It does not claim the universal higher-dimensional source-selection or same-divisor theorem; Phase I and Phase II release gates remain explicit.
notes: A Zenodo DOI is intentionally absent until an authorized GitHub release is archived and Zenodo issues the identifiers. Machine checks and human mathematical review are separate gates.
